died.name: Washington Irving
died.last_words: Well, I must arrange my pillows for another night – when will this end!

died.name: Pedro Muñoz Seca
died.cause: to his firing squad during the Paracuellos massacres
died.last_words: I am starting to believe you are not intending to count me among your friends!

died.name: John Dundas
died.desc: Second World War British fighter ace
died.cause: prior to being shot down and killed

died.name: Captain Dawid Jacobus Uys
died.desc: pilot of South African Airways Flight 295
died.cause: just after declared an emergency following an in-flight fire before planning to head to Mauritius for an emergency attempt

died.name: Greg Austin Gingrich
died.cause: While the 38-year-old was vacationing at the Grand Canyon in Coconino County, Arizona, with his teenaged daughter, he began to play-act losing his balance to frighten her. His daughter, unimpressed with his antics, walked on. Gingrich, however, missed his footing and fell approximately 400 ft into the canyon to his death.

born.name: John Bunyan
born.last_words: Take me, for I come to Thee.

born.name: Jean-Baptiste Lully
born.cause: The French composer died of a gangrenous abscess after accidentally piercing his foot with a staff while he was vigorously conducting a Te Deum. It was customary at that time to conduct by banging a staff on the floor. He refused to have his leg amputated so he could still dance.

born.name: Alfonso XII
born.last_words: I don't deserve to be cared for as you have cared for me. I know that when I have gone you will care for Spain as I have myself.

born.name: Stefan Zweig
born.cause: in his last testament before committing suicide with his wife, Lotte Altmann
born.last_words: I think it better to conclude in good time and in erect bearing a life in which intellectual labour meant the purest joy and personal freedom the highest good on Earth.

born.name: Herbert George Columbine
born.cause: to fellow soldiers after holding off the enemy for four hours with a Vickers machine gun at Hervilly Wood, France, during World War I

born.name: Archie R. Twitchell
born.cause: radio transmission after 1957 Pacoima mid-air collision
born.last_words: Were a midair collision – midair collision, 10 How we are going in-uncontrollable – uncontrollable – we are...we've had it boy – poor jet too – told you we should take chutes – say goodbye to everybody.

born.name: Lou Everett
born.cause: prior to failed ejection from Ryan XV-5 Vertifan
